title: Set aside (different measures): Two papers disagree on the finding. (Young adults over two weeks vs adolescents over years, and b)
explanation: Claim A asserts that social media use predicts declines in life satisfaction over time, whereas Claim B finds that the longitudinal within-person effect of social media use on life satisfaction is trivial in size.
a_text: Facebook use over a two-week period predicts declines in overall life satisfaction over time.
b_text: The median longitudinal within-person effect of social media use on life satisfaction was trivial in size (beta = -0.05).
